note: Hand-kept. The Snacky Shack's real menu with synthetic history: every order, cost, supplier and person here is invented. A demo world, so this key sits apart from the four evaluation keys and their coverage gate; test/snacky_shack.test.ts seeds the world with this seed and recomputes every entry. impact_minor is cents of AUD; every figure is typed from the worked arithmetic in `what`, never produced by the generator.

problems.what: channel aggregator:doordash takes 30% against a contracted 25% on 15 real orders (dated history bills DD-SS-SH-1..15, each two Special Snacky Boxes for 2 at 2,500 cents, GST inside: 5,000; 7 to 2 days back). The merchant collects the GST, so nothing is withheld and core's short per line = expected (5,000 - 1,250) - net (5,000 - 1,500) = 250, over the line rule max(2, ceil(3,750 x 50 / 10,000) = 19): 15 x 250
Beef smash patties invoiced 140 then 165 cents each (+18%): 3 deliveries x 400 patties x 25
